violations.text: Allergen advisory statement is lacking on menus. Allergen advisory is required to inform customers of their obligation to inform staff of any food allergies. Menu reprint discussed with owner. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2026

The screen door, located in the back, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

The cutting block on the food prep table is scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 01/26/2027
The floor tiles behind the counter (cookline and back prep room) are in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/26/2027
